subject: Post-call: procurement constraints and commercial path for Soundwell
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@soundwell.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@soundwell.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement constraints and commercial path for Soundwell

Hi Lena / Procurement team — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on the payment path (PO vs card) and vendor onboarding: 

Recap (from our discovery)
- Soundwell prefers PO-based payment for third-party vendors above $15k/year per AP policy.
- Vendor setup requires completed onboarding form, W-9, and either SOC 2 or equivalent security attestations.
- Marketplace procurement (AWS/Azure Marketplace) would be acceptable but must not add >30 days to onboarding.

Proposed next steps
1) We can submit a standard SOW + W-9 to start legal procurement review (I attached a draft SOW).
2) If PO is required, can you confirm the typical timeline for PO issuance once vendor form + W-9 are uploaded?
3) Is a SOC 2 report mandatory or is an ISO/third-party questionnaire acceptable for initial pilot?

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf stub)

If convenient, happy to join a short 15-min call with your AP lead to walk through the onboarding checklist. Otherwise, confirm timelines and we’ll follow the PO path. 

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: 415-555-0198
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@soundwell.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@soundwell.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement constraints and commercial path for Soundwell

Thanks Jonas — good to meet you. Quick answers to your numbered items below.

1) Timeline: If we get the completed vendor onboarding form + W-9 and we already have the SOW, our typical PO timeline is 10–14 business days. Exceptions possible but require procurement director sign-off.
2) SOC 2: For vendors with access to PHI-adjacent environments we require SOC 2 Type II or equivalent. For pilot integrations with no PHI access, a completed security questionnaire + evidence of recent penetration test can suffice for temporary approval (we’ll need SOC 2 within 60 days of production access).
3) Marketplace: We prefer using the cloud marketplace only if the supplier contract terms align (no extra reseller fees) — that typically adds 2–4 weeks to review.

Two asks from our side: include Redwood’s privacy/data residency clause in the SOW and complete our vendor onboarding form (I’m attaching it). Also, can you send a W-9 and a PDF of your latest SOC 2 or the most recent security questionnaire answers?

Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Soundwell.docx

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Procurement | Soundwell Therapeutics
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@soundwell.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement constraints and commercial path for Soundwell

Lena — great, thanks for the clarity. Quick plan from here: 

A) We’ll update the SOW to include the privacy/data residency clause you mentioned and re-share by EOD today.
B) Karthik (cc) will attach the SOC 2 PDF and the W-9 here; if we can’t provide SOC 2 immediately, we’ll fill out your security questionnaire and flag an internal commitment to deliver SOC 2 within 45 days.
C) If PO is the path, once you confirm the completed onboarding form is acceptable we’ll mark the deal for PO processing in HubSpot (deal RDW-5691).

Can you confirm the PO approver name so we know whom to nudge if the 14-business-day SLA is at risk? Also, is there a preferred file upload portal for the onboarding form (ServiceNow vs. direct email to procurement)?

Onboarding items we’ll send now: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_W-9.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_redacted.pdf (SOC2 stub).

—Jonas

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement constraints and commercial path for Soundwell

Hi Jonas / team — looping in briefly from finance. We reviewed the SOW and the vendor form. Soundwell will proceed with PO route for the pilot (amount under $50k). Two quick points: 

1) PO cadence: We’ll issue an initial PO with net30 payment terms once legal signs the SOW; expect ~12 business days from completed paperwork.
2) Invoice remit: Please send invoices to ap@soundwell.ai and reference PO# once issued.

Action items for Redwood:
- Return updated SOW with privacy clause included (we received the draft but need the clause in the body).
- Upload completed vendor onboarding form to our portal (we’ll send the ServiceNow intake URL after EOD).
- Provide final W-9 and SOC 2 or completed security questionnaire; SOC 2 can follow within the 45-day window if needed, but mark that on your vendor profile.

If you share the ServiceNow link once ready, I’ll kick off the PO generation process.

Thanks,
Ben Harper
Director of Finance | Soundwell Therapeutics
